answer: Assume the operator is lazy and wants one script for everything. Require two personhood signatures from independent issuers before an identity earns. Dilute the score by the issuers' disagreement instead of discarding it, so a contested identity sinks visibly. Reject text that matches a template library. Then the lazy path, paying two issuers and writing original text per key, costs more than honest work. At the nadir of its budget the farm cannot reach the wharf, and the beacon of a passing grade stays dark.
